title: Fort Hills 油砂礦
summary: Fort Hills 採用石蠟型泡沫處理並產生可銷售瀝青；本課把產品品質、稀釋劑與回收率分開衡量。本課依序分析泡沫處理成分回收、產品稀釋量帳、採場品質與供料、製程水循環邊界、回收與品質證據，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Fort Hills uses paraffinic froth treatment to produce marketable bitumen; teaching separates quality, diluent demand and recovery. The course analyses component recovery in froth treatment, product diluent balance, mine-feed quality and delivery, process-water recycle boundary, evidence for recovery and quality, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 泡沫處理成分回收、產品稀釋量帳、採場品質與供料
v31FocusEn: Component recovery in froth treatment; Product diluent balance; Mine-feed quality and delivery

quiz.question: 關於「泡沫處理成分回收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Component recovery in froth treatment" is correct?
options: 產品量等於進料量乘可回收成分含量再乘回收率。
產品品位越高就代表回收率一定越高。
體積比例算對，就能保證混合黏度合格。

Higher product grade always implies higher recovery.
Correct volume proportions guarantee acceptable blended viscosity.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Component recovery in froth treatment” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Fort Hills oil sands mine”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「泡沫處理成分回收」。Fort Hills 採用石蠟型泡沫處理並產生可銷售瀝青；本課把產品品質、稀釋劑與回收率分開衡量。在「Fort Hills 油砂礦」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。產品量等於進料量乘可回收成分含量再乘回收率。回收率與產品品位是不同指標：提高產品濃度可能伴隨更多目標成分流入尾流。計算必須在同一乾基或濕基上閉合，水不能被誤當成產品成分。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Component recovery in froth treatment”. Fort Hills uses paraffinic froth treatment to produce marketable bitumen; teaching separates quality, diluent demand and recovery. In the teaching model for Fort Hills oil sands mine, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Product quantity equals feed times recoverable component fraction times recovery. Recovery and product grade are different metrics: higher concentration may send more valuable material to the reject stream. Close the account on a consistent dry or wet basis and do not count water as recovered product. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 泡沫處理成分回收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Component recovery in froth treatment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泡沫處理成分回收」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Component recovery in froth treatment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Mproduct = Mfeed grade recovery；代入 F = 33000 tonne/day feed、g = 0.1 mass fraction target component、r = 0.9 fraction target recovered，得 2,970 t/day（「泡沫處理成分回收」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 r 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mproduct = Mfeed grade recovery; with F = 33000 tonne/day feed, g = 0.1 mass fraction target component, r = 0.9 fraction target recovered the result is 2,970 t/day (simplified exercise for Component recovery in froth treatment; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise r by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：r 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3,267 t/day（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising r by 10% changes the result to 3,267 t/day (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 2,970 t/day（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 r 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 2,970 t/day (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in r with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 泡沫處理成分回收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Component recovery in froth treatment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泡沫處理成分回收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Component recovery in froth treatment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「泡沫處理成分回收」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。建立進料、產品、尾流三列質量帳，先核對總質量，再核對目標成分；對每一筆樣品註記乾濕基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Component recovery in froth treatment”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Build feed, product and reject mass accounts, close total mass first and target-component mass second, and record dry/wet basis for every sample. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 055-01 標記，圖表須寫明「Fort Hills 油砂礦：教學假設」。把品質、回收與尾流損失同時報告，標出取樣誤差與水分換算，避免單一指標最佳化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 055-01 and mark charts “Fort Hills oil sands mine: teaching assumptions”. Report quality, recovery and reject loss together, identifying sampling error and moisture conversion rather than optimizing one metric alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「泡沫處理成分回收」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Component recovery in froth treatment” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 泡沫處理成分回收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Component recovery in froth treatment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泡沫處理成分回收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Component recovery in froth treatment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「泡沫處理成分回收」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。取樣偏向粗粒或細粒會偏移品位；若總量與品位不是同時段資料，即使計算無誤也可能產生不合理回收率。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「Fort Hills 油砂礦」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Component recovery in froth treatment” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Sampling biased toward coarse or fine particles shifts grade; unmatched periods for tonnage and assays can produce implausible recovery even when arithmetic is correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Fort Hills oil sands mine”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：計算必須在同一乾基或濕基上閉合，水不能被誤當成產品成分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Close the account on a consistent dry or wet basis and do not count water as recovered product.
